title: Card C — diabetic husband, skipped dinner, sweaty and confused

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 2210 Taraval Street. It's my husband, he's diabetic, he skipped dinner, and now he's sweaty and confused.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's mumbling, he's not making much sense. And he's shaky.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does he take insulin, and when did he last eat?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he took his insulin at five and then he didn't eat anything.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last acting normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About an hour ago, he was fine.
